Early-season Bundesliga high-flyers Freiburg have hit form again ahead of matchday nine, which sees them host a struggling Union Berlin side who look set to be in a relegation battle this term.

## Match News and Current Form [...] Freiburg have responded to three consecutive competitive defeats by winning their next three, beating Wolfsburg in the DFB-Pokal (3-2), Augsburg in the Bundesliga (2-1) and Trabzonspor in the UEFA Conference League (1-0). Sat in the top four with 16 points on the board (W5, D1, L2), this is their second-best start to a Bundesliga campaign ever, and they appear well-placed to challenge the club’s all-time best third-place finish achieved back in 1994/95.
